tagline: Leading provider of crude oil and petroleum product transportation services
hero_kpi_rationale: TCE Revenues is the key performance metric for tanker shipping companies, directly reflecting vessel operating profitability and maritime freight market dynamics

kpis.name: TCE Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated from maritime transportation activities calculated on a Time Charter Equivalent basis
kpis.description: TCE Revenues in 2025. Metric tracked annually by company analysts, historically available over the last 10 years.
kpis.signal: Decline in revenues due to lower spot maritime freight rates

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization adjusted for non-recurring items
kpis.signal: Decline in Adjusted EBITDA due to lower TCE revenues and freight rates

kpis.name: Fleet Size
kpis.explanation: Number of vessels operated by the company in service
kpis.description: Number of operating vessels as of December 31, 2025
kpis.signal: Stable operating fleet with 4 LR1 newbuilds on order for delivery in 2026

kpis.name: Income from Vessel Operations
kpis.explanation: Net revenue generated from vessel operations after operating expenses
kpis.signal: Decline in operating income due to lower average daily rates in the product tanker segment

kpis.name: Total Liquidity
kpis.explanation: Available cash and undrawn credit facilities used to finance operations
kpis.signal: Improved cash position reflecting strengthened balance sheet

kpis.name: Unencumbered Fleet
kpis.explanation: Number and percentage of vessels free of mortgage or lien
kpis.description: Unencumbered vessels as of December 31, 2025 (44% of fleet)
kpis.signal: 44% of fleet unencumbered, indicating increased financial flexibility

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €2.67 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €0.58 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: TCE Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated from maritime transportation activities calculated on a Time Charter Equivalent basis
kpis.signal: Decline in revenues due to lower spot maritime freight rates

risks.title: Fluctuations in charter rates and vessel values
risks.summary: The highly cyclical nature of the maritime shipping industry can lead to volatile changes in charter rates and vessel values, which could negatively impact the company's earnings and cash flows.
risks.score_rationale: Cyclical nature of the industry, direct exposure to freight rate market fluctuations, significant impact on financial results

risks.title: Geopolitical risks and sanctions
risks.summary: Geopolitical risks, including international conflicts, trade sanctions, and geopolitical disruptions, can affect the company's operations and financial results by altering trade routes and freight volumes.
risks.score_rationale: Ongoing conflicts (Russia-Ukraine, Middle East), direct impact on trade routes and freight volumes, explicitly detailed in the 10-K

risks.title: Significant debt
risks.summary: The company has significant debt which could affect its ability to finance operations and meet repayment obligations in the event of market deterioration.
risks.score_rationale: Identified leverage position, impact on financing capacity and debt servicing

risks.title: Counterparty credit risks
risks.summary: Credit risks associated with customers and financial counterparties may affect the company's ability to collect revenues and meet financial obligations.
risks.score_rationale: Exposure to major customers, potential impact on cash flow and revenue streams

risks.title: Environmental and maritime regulations
risks.summary: Increasing environmental regulations, including marine fuel standards and decarbonization requirements, may affect operating costs and financial results.
risks.score_rationale: Evolving IMO standards, higher compliance costs, impact on operating margins

risks.title: Dependence on spot market and revenue volatility
risks.summary: The company relies heavily on the spot market (82% of TCE revenues) for its revenues, making it vulnerable to significant fluctuations in charter rates and maritime market conditions.
risks.score_rationale: 82% of TCE revenues from spot market, significant exposure to volatile rates, lack of long-term visibility

risks.title: Global financial conditions and credit availability
risks.summary: The state of global financial markets may affect the company's ability to obtain additional financing on acceptable terms, particularly for funding its four LR1 newbuilds on order.
risks.score_rationale: Potential impact on financing operations and newbuild investment plans

ai_positioning.summary: The company INSW does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report. The information provided focuses on financial aspects, operating segments, and vessel operation strategies, with no reference to AI.
